Bridge plugs are `downhole tools used to isolate specific sections of a wellbore, allowing for zonal isolation, stimulation, or abandonment` . They can be permanent (drillable) or retrievable, featuring slips, a mandrel, and sealing elements that withstand high pressure, often up to 10,000 psi, and high temperatures.[[1]](https://alphaoiltools.com/bridge-plugs/#:~:text=Hydraulic%20Set%20Alpha%20Oil%20Tools%20manufactures%20a,maintaining%20the%20ability%20for%20future%20drill%20out.)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DGqkXqeID4s/)[[3]](https://silver-fox.net/downhole-tools/bridge-plugs/#:~:text=Bridge%20plugs%20are%20downhole%20tools%20composed%20primarily,either%20permanently%20or%20temporarily%20within%20the%20wellbore.)[[4]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/b/bridge_plug)[[5]](https://www.corelab.com/products/premium-bridge-plugs/)[[6]](https://www.oilfieldserviceprofessionals.com/retrievable-bridge-plugs#:~:text=The%20plug%20has%20the%20following%20features%20and,ability%20to%20hang%20gauges%20below%20the%20WRBP)

**Key Aspects of Bridge Plugs** 

- **Types:** Permanent/Millable plugs (for long-term abandonment) and Retrievable Bridge Plugs (RBP) (for temporary isolation).
- **Applications:** Used in multi-zone stimulation (fracturing, acidizing), cementing, and permanent plug-and-abandonment (P&A) operations.
- **Setting Methods:** Set via electric wireline, coiled tubing, or hydraulic setting tools.
- **Components:** Composed of anchoring slips (to grip the casing) and elastomer sealing elements.
- **Manufacturers:** Major providers include [Baker Hughes](https://www.bakerhughes.com/well-intervention/plug-and-abandonment-services/pa-barrier-installation/workover-systems/service-tools/bridge-plugs), [Halliburton](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs/cementing-retainers-bridge-plugs), [SLB (Schlumberger)](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/packers/blueplug-max-p-bridge-plug) , and [Expro](https://www.expro.com/products/maximus-bridge-plug).[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DGqkXqeID4s/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C64JeVFN3vN/)[[3]](https://www.bakerhughes.com/well-intervention/plug-and-abandonment-services/pa-barrier-installation/workover-systems/service-tools/bridge-plugs)[[4]](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/packers/blueplug-max-p-bridge-plug#:~:text=Effective%20barrier%20for%20remedial%20work%20and%20well,or%20remedial%20cement%20injection%20above%20the%20plug.)[[5]](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs/cementing-retainers-bridge-plugs#:~:text=High-performance%20tools%20for%20unconventional%20completions%20Halliburton%20drillable,in%20wellbore%20conditions%20up%20to%20425%E2%81%B0F%20%28218.3%E2%81%B0C%29.)[[6]](https://www.corelab.com/products/premium-bridge-plugs/)[[7]](https://www.expro.com/products/maximus-bridge-plug)[[8]](https://silver-fox.net/downhole-tools/bridge-plugs/#:~:text=Bridge%20plugs%20are%20downhole%20tools%20composed%20primarily,either%20permanently%20or%20temporarily%20within%20the%20wellbore.)[[9]](https://www.oilfieldserviceprofessionals.com/retrievable-bridge-plugs#:~:text=The%20plug%20has%20the%20following%20features%20and,ability%20to%20hang%20gauges%20below%20the%20WRBP)

- **Temporary Isolation:** Retrievable plugs D&L Oil Tools WR Bridge Plug isolate a lower zone while testing or treating an upper zone.
- **Permanent Abandonment:** [Owen Oil Tools' Premium Bridge Plugs](https://www.corelab.com/products/premium-bridge-plugs/) ensure a sealed wellbore, tested up to 10,000 psi.
- **High-Pressure Zones:** Expro's Maximus Bridge Plug uses carbide button slips to manage high pressures and temperatures.[[1]](https://dloiltools.com/products/wr-bridge-plug/#:~:text=The%20WR%20Bridge%20Plug%20is%20a%20wireline,utilizes%20standard%20wireline%20or%20hydraulic%20setting%20tools.)[[2]](https://www.corelab.com/products/premium-bridge-plugs/)[[3]](https://www.expro.com/products/maximus-bridge-plug)

**Key Advantages** 

- **Cost Efficiency:** Reduces the need for multiple trips during interventions.
- **Versatility:** Compatible with various casing sizes and grades, including high-grade P-110.
- **Reliability:** High-performance sealing systems (e.g., SLB BluePlug Max P ) provide secure barriers against gas or fluids.[[1]](https://www.bakerhughes.com/well-intervention/plug-and-abandonment-services/pa-barrier-installation/workover-systems/service-tools/bridge-plugs)[[2]](https://www.corelab.com/products/magna-range-bridge-plugs/)[[3]](https://www.corelab.com/products/premium-bridge-plugs/)[[4]](https://owendata.corelab.com/owen/cms/docs/Brochures/BridgePlugs.pdf)[[5]](https://www.slb.com/products-and-services/innovating-in-oil-and-gas/completions/well-completions/packers/blueplug-max-p-bridge-plug#:~:text=Effective%20barrier%20for%20remedial%20work%20and%20well,or%20remedial%20cement%20injection%20above%20the%20plug.)

expanded_element.title: The Uses of Retrievable Bridge Plugs - Northstar Downhole Specialists
expanded_element.description: A bridge plug is a specialist downhole tool designed to isolate wellbore at a chosen depth. When set, bridge plugs prevent fluids from a lower zone reaching an upper zone or the surface.

items.title: What is the difference between a bridge plug and a cement plug?

expanded_element.title: Cement Retainers vs. Bridge Plugs: Essential Well Tools
expanded_element.description: The bridge plug is another downhole tool widely used in oil and gas well operations, but its function differs significantly from that of a cement retainer. Unlike cement retainers, which allow for fluid flow control, a bridge plug provides complete isolation of the wellbore section below it.

expanded_element.title: bridge plug - Energy Glossary - SLB
expanded_element.description: 1. n. [Perforating, Well Completions] A downhole tool that is located and set to isolate the lower part of the wellbore. Bridge plugs may be permanent or retrievable, enabling the lower wellbore to be permanently sealed from production or temporarily isolated from a treatment conducted on an upper zone.

expanded_element.title: API 11D1 Packers & Bridge Plugs Supplier | Completion Isolation Tools
expanded_element.description: Packer vs bridge plug — what's the difference? A packer typically isolates annular space to enable controlled production/injection; a bridge plug is primarily a barrier plug to isolate sections of the wellbore for intervention or abandonment stages.
